name: design-pipeline
description: Design before code for side projects without a designer: an interview that turns an order into a brief, a design system picked from rendered directions, clickable HTML prototypes per flow, a clean-context design review, and a handoff that stage-pipeline reads as its prototype design source. Routes each surface to the right third-party skill (Impeccable, taste-skill, ui-ux-pro-max, Emil Kowalski's motion skills)
